name: Agentic Awesome Skills
description: Agentic Awesome Skills (AAS), formerly Antigravity Awesome Skills, is an open-source library of reusable SKILL.md instructions for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and other coding agents.
licenseSummary: Original code and tooling use MIT. Original written content uses CC BY 4.0; imported skills retain their own licenses and attribution requirements.
nextStep: Choose a skill or a pack, inspect its files, and follow the setup guide for your agent.
